meta.name: add-rtk
meta.description: Install rtk token-compression proxy into agent containers. Routes Bash tool calls through rtk for 60–90% token savings on dev commands (git, cargo, pytest, docker, kubectl, etc.).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在容器中安装 rtk 代理以压缩令牌，节省开发命令的令牌消耗
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果使用 AI 辅助开发且想减少令牌消耗
copy.tagline_en: Install rtk proxy in containers to compress tokens and save on dev commands
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use AI-assisted development and want to reduce token usage

howto.what: 装上后,agent 容器里每次 Bash 调用都会经 rtk 代理过滤,压缩 git、cargo、pytest、docker、kubectl 等开发命令的输出,以节省 token。它通过 settings.json 里的 PreToolUse hook 自动生效,不需要在 CLAUDE.md 写指令。
howto.when: 当 rtk 装到主机、挂载进容器,并在该 agent group 的 settings.json 写入 PreToolUse hook 后,Claude 每次执行 Bash 命令时都会自动接管。

say.note: rtk 会静默拦截这条 Bash 调用

say.text: 运行 pytest 看看测试结果
say.note: 输出先经 rtk 压缩再返回

say.text: 执行 docker ps 列出容器
say.note: 这条命令的输出同样被 rtk 过滤

howto.what_en: After install, every Bash call in the agent container goes through the rtk proxy, compressing output of dev commands (git, cargo, pytest, docker, etc.) to save tokens. It activates automatically via the settings.json PreToolUse hook.
howto.when_en: Once rtk is installed on the host, mounted into the container, and the PreToolUse hook is written into that group's settings.json, every Bash command Claude runs is handled automatically.

say_en.note: rtk intercepts this Bash call silently

say_en.text: Run pytest and show me the results
say_en.note: Output is filtered through rtk first

say_en.text: Run docker ps to list containers
say_en.note: This output goes through rtk too
